static_traits.name: Chen Kaiwen
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可以交流，但难以与他们讨论自己的Social anxiety；Interpersonal relationships因负面想法与避免眼神接触而受影响
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；not yet接受其他心理治疗；其他心理问题史Not mentioned
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to explain their own thoughts and feelings; positive attitude, high cooperation; subjectively feels nervous; able to accept homework and suggestions

basic_info.main_problem: Has difficulty making eye contact in social interactions, and believes friends think they are strange and only associate with them out of sympathy.
basic_info.core_demands: 意识到Social anxiety与对友谊的负面想法影响日常生活与心理健康，因此寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 在青少年时期经历过几次尴尬的社交事件；自那以后在社交场合尽量避免眼神接触，逐步形成对群体互动的Social anxiety与对他人负面评价的担忧。

core_beliefs: I am a strange person who evokes pity
do not人并not真正喜欢我，他们只是出于同情与我做朋友

special_situations.event: 在Social gatherings与朋友交谈时，注意到有人给出“奇怪的眼神”
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能维持眼神接触或看到do not人露出not寻常的表情，就说明他们觉得I am strange
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to avoid eye contact, reducing speaking and interaction in group settings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are judging me; they are only friends with me out of pity

special_situations.event: Thinks about communicating honestly with friends and seeking clarification
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我暴露自己的担忧与not安，do not人会觉得我反应过度并开始更怜悯我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与朋友讨论Social anxiety与眼神接触的问题
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会开始以not同的方式对待我，会更可怜我

special_situations.event: After recalling experiences of friends' past support and understanding
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 即使出现积极互动，也not代表他们真正喜欢我，这些好表现只是出于同情
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive evidence, continuing to interpret relationships from a negative perspective
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是同情我才支持我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be genuinely accepted and understood and to build natural, comfortable connections with others
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged and humiliated, worrying that others only feel sympathy rather than genuinely liking oneself
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged and humiliated by reducing self-exposure and keeping a certain distance
Avoids eye contact to maintain a sense of safety and controllability

object_relations.self_representation: 被评判、令人同情的自己
object_relations.object_representation: 会评判、只会同情而not真正接纳的他人（朋友）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests seeking clarification from friends and openly discussing worries
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向认为这样会让朋友更看低自己、只会更可怜自己（将内在的羞耻与not被接纳的担忧Projection到他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以支持性、温和的语气充分Empathy其担忧，再通过具体事实与例证进行苏格拉底式Questioning，温柔挑战“他们会看not起我”的推断，避免对抗或评判。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks 'is there concrete evidence of friends' negative views'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者强调他人的眼神与“看起来奇怪”，将其作为not与朋友沟通的理由，忽视积极证据
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains a neutral and curious tone, guides them to make the details and situations of the 'strange looks' concrete, and at the same time jointly lists pros and cons evidence and alternative explanations, reducing defensive intensity.

manifestations: Feels alienated from others in group settings because of avoiding eye contact
担心朋友只是出于同情与自己相处而not敢坦诚交流

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interpreting others' gazes and expressions as judgments of oneself
Believes friends associate with oneself only out of sympathy

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection和反省，包含过多自我限制与自我苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎，与“自主性”对应。
manifestations: Over-focusing on others' gazes and reactions, avoiding eye contact
担心坦诚后会被视为“反应过度”而选择not交流

exception_events.target_problem: 在与朋友或群体交流时，来访者通常会回避眼神接触，并假设他人对其有负面评价，从而感到更Anxiety、关系疏远。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 有几次与朋友相处时，来访者感到比较舒适，朋友表现出理解与支持，他have not像往常那样强烈回避，互动更顺畅。
exception_events.reason: not同支持：朋友在这些时刻表达了理解与接纳；not同情境/做法：来访者当时主观感到更舒适，从而更愿意接触。

positive_force: Willing to seek counseling and has a positive attitude
能够识do not并表达自身的负面自动化思维
Has a few friends to communicate with and has experienced their support
negative_force: 在群体情境中Social anxiety显著
Mind reading and personalization tendencies, prone to ignoring positive evidence
回避眼神接触导致互动质量下降与Impaired self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: 在社交互动中回避眼神接触
target_behavior.core_reason: After embarrassing social experiences in adolescence, worry about being judged and a mind-reading tendency formed, leading to avoidance of eye contact
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判/羞耻的潜在风险，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships疏远，Work performance affected，Lowered self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: 在群体场合出现显著Social anxiety
antecedent: Moments requiring public interaction or being noticed
target_behavior.core_reason: 基于过去尴尬经历与对他人负面评价的Anticipation，倾向灾难化解释社交线索
target_behavior.function: Avoids being noticed and evaluated by others, seeks a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduces expression and participation, hard to maintain intimate relationships, daily interactions affected
